Following the release of U.S. inflation data, interest rate pressure on the gold market has further weakened. TD Securities believes that the latest CPI data did not drive the market to significantly raise expectations for Federal Reserve rate hikes, suggesting that precious metals still retain some foundation for upward movement. As the market had already begun to reduce bets on further U.S. rate hikes, the current price performance of gold reflects more of a repricing of future policy paths [...] Image 12
